title: STORY SERIES: BEYOND HERE OPEN
lines: 01 NEW STORY SERIES EVENT: BEYOND HERE OPEN
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Wondrous Postcard, Materials, etc.

DETAILS: Beyond Here event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Wondrous Postcards from clearing all the stages except Annihilation and Extreme Mode to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments in Local Office. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories of current or past Vignette/Story Series.
Cambrian Series - Frosted Breath for Silence, Information Fragments, Furniture Parts, Battle Records, Recruitment Permits, Elite Materials, etc.
After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Intelligence.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – THE WHEAT AND THE ANTHEM
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "The Wheat And The Anthem", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting "The Wheat And The Anthem", and will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
Archetto, Iris, and Beanstalk will gain more trust during this event.
04 CAMBRIAN SERIES NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Cambrian Series - Soft Wool for Bibeak
Cambrian Series - Modeling Night for Gravel
05 NEW FURNITURE SET – THE ZEN GARDEN
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, The Zen Garden, will be available at the Store for a limited time.

DETAILS: The Grand Knight Territory will be replaced by New Annihilation Mission Frozen Abandoned City. The Grand Knight Territory will be added to the list of Hypothetical Annihilation Targets after it ends.
